primarySources.finding: Pinned Apple XNU explicitly documents persistence of previously fsynced data on the same device after F_FULLFSYNC returns; it also includes fsync of the final descriptor. This supports the ordering contract under stated filesystem/device assumptions, not a hardware power-loss certification.
Integer conversion truncates out-of-range values and maps nonfinite values to zero; validate finite integer range before conversion.

decision: Reject metadata-only candidates as inconsistent. Native prototype narrows the durability API uncertainty, fixes numeric descriptor admission, verifies live-worker termination and selected queue/failure ordering, and shows substantial concurrent latency improvement. Production adoption remains pending explicit native owner/distribution/binary-inclusive identity, platform fallback, topology/mixed-device and full frozen resource qualification. Preserve fsync/FULL and v12 runtime.
